commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the seven marked towers of the Unbound order business; a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. This is my own errand, not the order's. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it, which seems suspicious. 2. Get into Fort Chalkmoth keep and see its cellar, starting here at the fort gate. 3. Talk to the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan for leave to enter, or find another way in unseen (the keep door is locked; there is a guardroom door). Illusion could help me persuade or slip past the Sarpa Raiders. 4. I do not know who the Sarpa Raiders are or why they are here, nor what moans in the cellar. I can find out by talking to people and looking around.

answer 1. The captain will open the keep only if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing chalk carts on the western approach; he pays 100 gold. I still want to see the cellar for my own errand. 2. Either kill the raiders at the western approach and report back to Sakeeus-Wan, or use the trapdoor in the yard. 3. Fight the raiders; sneak in via the trapdoor in the yard unseen; use illusion on guards. 4. I do not know what the trapdoor leads to or what moans in the cellar; I can look around the yard.
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom

answer 1. The guardroom door took me in unseen via the yard trapdoor into the cellar guardroom. If the garrison sees me they will attack. I am here to learn what moans in the cellar, for my own errand. 2. Look at the sap jars in the quartermaster store, speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, and try the locked cellar door. 3. Talk to the gaoler (maybe with illusion), look at the jars, try or pick the cellar door, or leave. 4. I do not know what the sap jars (Jal-Veesa Knot marker) mean or what is behind the cellar door; I can find out by looking and talking.
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom

answer 1. Something moans behind the locked cellar door, fed with Hist sap tied with Jal-Veesa's knot in a fort with no Hist. The order's gaoler wont open it; Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key, and she dismissed the matter. 2. Go back to the hunt: Bell Station, by boat from Lilmoth, to ask the divers which drowned tower is marked. 3. Bell Station first; or pick the cellar door lock (I did not try); or confront Never-Writes-Twice about the key. 4. I do not know who is held in the cellar or why the order feeds them sap; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or Jal-Veesa's tree-minder.

answer Notes: I went to Fort Chalkmoth (Archwarden fort, Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara). Captain Sakeeus-Wan offered 100 gold to kill three Sarpa raiders for keep access, but I took the yard trapdoor unseen into the cellar guardroom instead. Gaoler Tsleel-Vaku refused my illusion and persuasion; the cellar door is locked, key held by Never-Writes-Twice. Jars of Hist sap with Jal-Veesa's knot are stacked in the quartermaster store, in a fort with no Hist; something moans behind the door. Never-Writes-Twice hid this, so she is suspect. Unknown: who is in the cellar. I still carry 1050 gold, 2 lockpicks, the Unbound recipe note, Keystone, paralysis poison x3, rapier and more. Next: Bell Station by boat from Lilmoth for the marked drowned tower; Vanin the Collector is digging ahead. Option later: pick the cellar door or ask Jal-Veesa's tree-minder.
